change: Restore official missing models and textures without modifying upstream bytes or credits; no foreign plugin code or configuration is imported.
version_scope: Baskets, rope fences and wild plants also exist in the checked official 1.21 and 26.1 branches. Egg cartons, skewers and the recovered expanded crates/bags belong to this fixed experimental feature snapshot; do not describe them as stable mod parity.

independent_extensions.author: ydxc2009
independent_extensions.definition: Independently defined handheld item model; uses the existing verified official iron_knife texture with a copper constant tint configured by this project. No copper bitmap is imported.
independent_extensions.version_scope: Plugin extension enabled from Minecraft 1.21.9; not present in any of the three audited official branches.
